title: RAPTOR: Reasoned Agentic Portfolio Trading with Orchestrated Rebalancing
central_strategy: Run fundamental, technical, sentiment, valuation, bull/bear, risk, and execution agents over point-in-time price/news/filing/macro inputs; map categorical views into Black-Litterman returns; estimate covariance; solve a long-only constrained portfolio; and rebalance on the paper's orchestrated schedule.

preserved_components: All 166 released daily portfolio snapshots and 18 scalar results verified directly from author output.
Current public benchmark response and paper-internal checks bring 29/42 displayed scalar units to verified status under explicit lineage boundaries.
Three published raster-curve correspondences and the native rolling Sharpe/Sortino/Calmar postprocessor are independently verified.
required_but_missing: Paper-time equity prices and benchmark, Finnhub, Reddit, SimFin, Perplexity, point-in-time memberships, and exact API requests/responses.
Full blackboard messages/tool calls, per-date security decisions beyond January 1, prompts/model state, seeds, and agent rerun records.
A consistent cadence and configuration: the paper and runners conflict on frequency, lookback, risk aversion, tau, universe, and view construction.
The missing stock_prices.csv required by the candidate backtest, transaction fee/slippage deductions, WAB trace, and complete result generator.
A transferable rule for producing monthly top-1,000 U.S. security views and weights over 1999-2024.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_snapshots_are_not_a_transferable_pol: The 166 snapshots verify one 2025 portfolio output path. They do not expose the agent inputs or dated per-security decisions needed to generate holdings for other dates, names, or the JKP history.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_day0_decisions_are_insufficient: Only January 1 has 503 decision files; headers are long-only rewritten and some BUY outputs conflict with sell/reduce rationales. Reusing them every month would invent a persistence policy.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_black_litterman_component_is_not_rap: The core allocator can consume supplied views, but JKP does not contain RAPTOR's agent views. Feeding generic characteristic scores into it would replace the multi-agent reasoning mechanism.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_jkp_cannot_fill_the_gap: JKP supplies price/characteristic histories, not the paper-time multimodal agent state, categorical views, or orchestration. Output snapshots cannot be extrapolated backward without fabricating actions.
monthly_jkp_assessment.result_credit_boundary: Strong output/raster verification remains original-paper evidence, not a new common-benchmark strategy run or end-to-end agent reproduction.

closure_rule: Do not promote output replay, one-day decisions, the metric postprocessor, supplied-view Black-Litterman code, or generic JKP views to RAPTOR. Reopen for complete point-in-time inputs and action/blackboard lineage or a causal released policy.
